summary: MindWalk Holdings Corp. (formerly ImmunoPrecise Antibodies Ltd.) filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Meeting and Record Date dated September 21, 2026, for its upcoming Annual General Meeting. The AGM is scheduled for November 17, 2026, as a virtual meeting, with record dates for notice, voting, and beneficial ownership determination all set at October 13, 2026. The notice covers common shares under CUSIP 602687105 / ISIN CA6026871054. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice.
